title: A measure in a FILTER predicate is evaluated for the current row, not for the total
query: EVALUATE FILTER ( ADDCOLUMNS ( VALUES ( Sales[ProductKey] ), "S", [Sales Amount] ), [S] >= [Sales Amount] * 0.5 )

source.quote: the query really checks the sales of a product against 1% of the sales of the same product
source.supports: a measure reference in the FILTER condition is wrapped in CALCULATE, so each row is compared with its own sales, not with the total

source.quote: ADDCOLUMNS does not preserve the data lineage of the added columns for a following context transition
source.supports: the added column S has no lineage; the transition in FILTER filters Sales[ProductKey] only

derivation: ProductKey 1: 100 + 200 + 100 = 400; 2: 40 + 20 = 60; 3: 50 + 30 = 80. In the predicate [Sales Amount] is evaluated under the transition on Sales[ProductKey], so it equals S: 400 >= 200, 60 >= 30, 80 >= 40 are all true and all 3 rows stay. Against the grand total (540 * 0.5 = 270) only key 1 would stay.
notes: SUM of a fixed decimal (currency) column is taken to be a fixed decimal, as in the seed cases.
